newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan c. bank says no plans to quell stock market.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan c. bank says no plans to quell stock market.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank would not adjust monetary policy to calm the stock market, which has been volatile in recent sessions on political fears, a central bank official on Friday quoted central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong as saying.

"The recent drastic ups and downs in the stock market were not affected by financial factors, so the central bank has no need to adjust its current monetary policy to intervene the stock market," the official quoted Sheu as saying late on Thursday when he returned an annual Asian Development Bank meeting in Japan.
